name: Newhaven, Docks
desc1: You stand at the southernmost edge of Newhaven. The view from here is
desc2: amazing. As you stare out across the Silver river you behold such
desc3: sights as the notorious Port Blackwater to the west, and the fabled
desc4: town of Silvermere southwards. A large half-shaven man sits off in the
desc5: corner, with what looks to be a fishing rod, and there are a number of
desc6: small skiffs tied to the dock for use in reaching the docks of
